verses.gurmukhi: ਜੈਸੇ ਦੀਪ ਦਿਪਤ ਭਵਨ ਉਜਿਆਰੋ ਹੋਤ ਸਗਲ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਗ੍ਰਿਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿ ਦਿਖਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: jaise dheep dhipat bhavan ujiaaro hot sagal samagree gireh pragaT dhikhaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as a house is lit up when a lamp is lighted in it, it makes everything visible clearly;

verses.gurmukhi: ਓਤਿ ਪੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੋਤ ਕਾਰਜ ਬਾਛਤ ਸਿਧਿ ਆਨੰਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜਿ ਬਿਹਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: ot pot jot hot kaaraj baachhat sidh aana(n)dh binodh sukh sahaj bihaat hai ||

en.bdb: With light spreading all around, all the tasks can be accomplished with ease and the time passes in peace and happiness;

verses.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਚ ਲੁਭਾਇ ਰਸ ਲੁਬਿਤ ਨਾਨਾ ਪਤੰਗ ਬੁਝਤ ਹੀ ਅੰਧਕਾਰ ਭਏ ਅਕੁਲਾਤ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: laalach lubhai ras lubit naanaa pata(n)g bujhat hee a(n)dhakaar bhe akulaat hai ||

en.bdb: Just as many moths are enamoured by the light of the lamp but are distressed when the light goes off and darkness descends;

verses.gurmukhi: ਤੈਸੇ ਬਿਦਮਾਨਿ ਜਾਨੀਐ ਨ ਮਹਿਮਾ ਮਹਾਂਤ ਅੰਤਿਰੀਛ ਭਏ ਪਾਛੇ ਲੋਗ ਪਛੁਤਾਤ ਹੈ ॥੩੫੦॥
verses.translit_en: taise bidhamaan jaaneeaai na mahimaa mahaa(n)t a(n)tireechh bhe paachhe log pachhutaat hai ||350||

en.bdb: Just as those alive do not value a lamp until it turns off, similarly people repent and feel sad for not taking advantage of the presence of the True Guru after they have gone. They do not bother to know the greatness of the True Guru. (350)
